subject: Energy
title: Battery Recycling
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Battery Recycling.

hook.text: Millions of EV and grid batteries will reach end-of-life this decade—recycling recovers valuable metals and cuts waste.

buildup.text: Lithium, cobalt, nickel, and manganese can be extracted and reused—reducing the need for new mining.

discovery.text: Hydrometallurgical processes dissolve battery materials in acid—recovering metals with over 95% efficiency.

twist.text: Before recycling, many EV batteries get a 'second life'—repurposed for less demanding grid storage applications.

climax.text: Redwood Materials and Li-Cycle are scaling recycling plants—aiming to create a closed-loop battery supply chain.

punchline.text: Old batteries become new ones—recycling closes the loop.

quiz.question: What happens to many EV batteries before recycling?
options: They get a second life in grid storage
